name: custom-tabs
description: Add your own sidebar tabs, each with a name and an icon, and drag panes into them. Create, rename, change the icon of, or delete a tab from the tab strip's right-click menu, the command palette, or this extension's settings. Deleting a tab sends its panes back where they came from.
